items.title: PentesterFlow – AI Tool for Penetration Testers and Bug Hunters to Automate Workflows
items.description: PentesterFlow is a new open-source, human-in-the-loop agentic AI command-line tool built specifically for penetration testers and bug bounty hunters, designed to automate recon-to-reporting workflows without sacrificing analyst oversight. Most agentic AI security tools suffer from hallucinated findings, weak context retention, and poor tool integration, but PentesterFlow tackles these problems…
